name: Bushy seaoxeye
desc: Bushy seaoxeye (Borrichia frutescens): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 39 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Borrichia frutescens is a North American species of flowering plants in the family Asteraceae known by the common names sea oxeye, sea oxeye daisy, bushy seaside tansy, and sea-marigold.
